LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text in every supported locale. en_us is required; missing locales fall back to it.

description:
A group of texts sharing the translation key prefix ``<id>.realmforge.``, for example ``key`` for key
mapping names (``key.realmforge.dark_vision``) or ``message`` for chat and action bar messages.

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

texts.description: Text name (lowercase snake_case) -> text; the key is <id>.realmforge.<name>.
texts.title: Texts
